title: Split repository inspection into bounded constant-time probes
trigger_preconditions: A compound inspection combines recursive Git status, file reads, and metadata collection under one short timeout.
failure_signature: The compound inspection timed out before returning any evidence even though each required fact could be checked independently.
candidate_workaround: Run file existence and size, syntax compilation, and Git state as separate bounded probes; credit only completed probes.
recurrence_guard: Keep potentially recursive Git inspection separate from constant-time filesystem and syntax checks, and never treat a timed-out wrapper as a partial pass.
rollback: Give the compound command zero inspection credit and leave repository content unchanged until bounded probes complete.
scope_boundary: Owner-local workflow inspection only; no full-suite, production, scientific, authority, or independent-reproduction credit.
